sections.text:
Ability Power 260. Damages all enemies 3-6 times with magic dark damage with a success value of 50.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Casts karma on all enemies.
-Casts kismet on all allies.
-70% chance to cast awakening on all allies.
-70% chance to cast resurrection on all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 6500
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the success value of the 260-Ability-Power attack that deals magic dark damage to all enemies 3-6 times with a success value of 50 by 30.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 6500
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the activation chance of resurrection by 30%.
